description: This file implements a cascade delete operation for a chapter in a learning or content management system. It deletes associated data such as PDFs, questions, attempts, images, RAG conversations, embeddings, and the chapter entry itself, ensuring all related resources are cleaned up.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class managing vector embeddings storage, including loading, saving, and metadata management.

methods.name: cascade_delete_chapter
methods.description: Deletes a chapter and all related data, including files, questions, attempts, images, RAG conversations, embeddings, and the chapter record itself, returning statistics about the deletion process.
